title: Your first hour with motion designer
description: Dive into the world of motion graphics with ‘Your First Hour in Unreal Designer’ for Unreal Engine 5. This introductory course is designed to fast-track your understanding of the motion design module. Experience the thrill of transforming static elements into captivating animations as you navigate through Unreal Engine’s robust Motion Designer module. Learn to master viewport controls, geometry modifiers, and the art of importing assets, including SVGs. Perfect for aspiring motion designers, this course promises a solid foundation in just one hour. Start your design journey with confidence and creativity!
